title: Monday Night Blues Jam
event_description: The longest-running blues jam session in the nation hosted by the Soulard Blues Band. SBB plays a full opening set then opens the stage to sit-in musicians for blues R&B and rock jams that run deep into the night.
sign_up: Yes - sign up at the door
event_venue_information: $5 cover / $3 for performing musicians. Award-winning Cajun and Creole food served. Historic 1840s building. Two covered outdoor patios.

title: Monday Night Open Mic
event_description: St. Louis's longest-running open mic hosted for over 30 years in one of the city's most eclectic venues. All genres welcome in this mosaic-covered art bar.
sign_up: Yes - sign up at the door
event_venue_information: Cash-only bar. No food menu on-site. Happy hour Mon-Sat. Outdoor mosaic patio with turtle pond. No cover.

title: Tuesday Jazz Jam
event_description: Weekly open jazz jam welcoming musicians of all ages and skill levels. Host Robert Edwards leads a house ensemble that provides a solid foundation for sit-in players to explore standards bebop and swing.
backline: Piano - bass - drums house rhythm section
event_venue_information: $5 cover - musicians free. Under 21 welcome with parent/guardian. Full bar with beer wine and spirits.

title: WORDUP! Open Mic
event_description: A high-energy weekly showcase of live music poetry and comedy celebrating St. Louis's diverse creative community. Now in its 10th year WORDUP! is a cultural institution drawing emerging artists across all disciplines.
backline: PA system and DJ setup provided
sign_up: Yes - sign up at door (limited slots; early arrival encouraged)
event_venue_information: Tickets available online or at door. Handicap/wheelchair accessible. Show is live-streamed. Limited seating.

title: Tuesday Open Mic
event_description: A diverse Tuesday open mic with acoustic performances early in the evening followed by electric sets with a three-piece house band. Third Tuesdays feature a Super Jam with members of prominent local groups.
event_time_plain: 8 PM acoustic / 10 PM electric with house band
sign_up: Yes - sign up at the door
event_venue_information: Intimate dive bar on The Hill. Pizza from Yonders Eats available. Happy hour 4-7 PM. Full bar with stiff cocktails and craft beers. No cover.

title: Wednesday Bluegrass & Old-Time Jam
event_description: A community jam celebrating the acoustic string traditions of bluegrass and old-time music. Fiddlers banjo players mandolinists guitarists and bassists gather to play traditional tunes in an informal all-are-welcome format.
event_venue_information: Acoustic only. No amplification. Family friendly. Light cafe fare and beverages available.

title: Wednesday Blues Jam
event_description: Jimmy Lee's weekly blues jam in the heart of Soulard - one of St. Louis's most storied music neighborhoods. A loose late-night session for blues players to trade licks and build community.
event_venue_information: Soulard neighborhood blues institution. Full bar. Classic American fare from kitchen.
